description: This file defines a Dart service class that interacts with the OpenAI ChatAPI. It includes error handling via an enum and exception class, and implements a chat service interface. The primary functionality is to send messages to the OpenAI API and parse responses, with specific attention to API errors and response content extraction.

classes.name: ChatGPTError
classes.description: Enum representing possible errors from the OpenAI API, such as invalid URL, invalid response, or no content.

classes.name: ChatGPTException
classes.description: Exception wrapper class for ChatGPTError, providing human-readable messages.

classes.name: OpenAIChatService
classes.description: Service class that implements the ChatService interface to communicate with the OpenAI chat completions API.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Asynchronously sends chat messages to the OpenAI API and returns the assistant's reply as a string.
